best_for: Windows users who want a Notepad replacement with syntax highlighting, regex search and encoding tools, and who like a build that runs from a USB stick.
description:
Notepad3 is a free text editor for Windows from Rizonesoft. It builds on Notepad2 by Florian Balmer and the Notepad2-mod fork by XhmikosR, and it uses the Scintilla editing engine.

Its syntax coloring reaches well past the usual languages, from Bash, Rust and Go to LaTeX, Markdown, YAML, TOML and AutoHotkey scripts, and it even reads old NFO files with ANSI art. You can undo and redo many steps. Rizonesoft says it does not collect or store personal data when you download, and that the update check only compares your version with the latest one online. If your browser or antivirus warns about the download, Rizonesoft says the file is clean.

points.title: Free, BSD licensed, donation funded
points.text: Notepad3 is released under the BSD 3-Clause license and costs nothing. Rizonesoft keeps it free through small donations, which go through PayPal without needing a PayPal account.

points.title: It can replace Windows Notepad
points.text: The installer offers to stand in for the built-in Notepad through a registry setting, or to install alongside it. Either way, double-clicked text files can open in Notepad3.

points.title: Coding basics in a small editor
points.text: You get syntax highlighting for C, C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, SQL and more, plus code folding, bracket matching, auto indent, word completion, bookmarks and find and replace with regular expressions.

points.title: Fixes encodings and line endings
points.text: It converts between ASCII, UTF-8 and UTF-16, and between Windows CR/LF, Unix LF and old Mac CR line endings. Handy when a file from another system shows up as one long line.

points.title: A portable edition, from Rizonesoft
points.text: Rizonesoft also offers a portable build that runs from a USB drive and writes no settings to the registry. The installers listed here are the 32-bit and 64-bit setup programs, which install for all users.

points.title: Windows only, short history
points.text: Notepad3 grew out of Notepad2 and ships the MiniPath file browser. It runs only on Windows, no Arm64 build is listed, and the Windows listing keeps 6 versions.
